scenes.text: An equation says two quantities are equal. Use inverse operations to solve for the unknown.
Solve x plus 12 equals 42. The answer is 30. x equals 42 minus 12 equals 30.
A box in a recycling club has 24 stickers plus x more; altogether there are 40. What is x? Pause the video and think.
A box in a recycling club has 24 stickers plus x more; altogether there are 40. What is x? The answer is 16. x equals 40 minus 24 equals 16.
